accessibility.evidence: Source notes use keyboard-operable native details/summary; map links have descriptive text and open the named location without geolocation permission. Existing text/focus tokens preserved. Headings and link names reviewed in rendered hidden collection and place guide.

responsive.evidence: Places, Stories, Hidden Udaipur, badges, trails and Lake Pichola rendered at 390x844 and 1440x900. Automated no-horizontal-overflow assertions pass. Fifteen detail routes and all three trail stop counts validated.

loading.evidence: Fixed cached gallery image race by checking image.complete on attachment; final browser check waits for both gallery images to leave loading state.

empty.evidence: New guides without rights-cleared photographs retain the existing illustrated fallback. No unavailable venue photographs are presented as real.

error.evidence: Content checker rejects invalid badge thresholds and missing hidden-place references; added unit tests pass. No runtime error occurred in rendered page checks.

partial.evidence: Place guides expose source references and approximate-coordinate notes; unknown accessibility and current hours are retained as unconfirmed. Curated spots search named map listings instead of navigating to lake-centre coordinates.

success.evidence: 15 places, 20 stories, 10 curated stops, 3 trails and 6 badge definitions loaded with expected browser counts. All place and trail detail pages return 200.

permission.reason: Content browsing and named map searches do not request device permissions. No accounts, uploads or booking permissions are introduced.

renderedEvidence.observation: Ten location guides with readable text, guide links, map searches and source/access notes.
Expanded collection retains readable line lengths and working source disclosures on desktop.
